hook_text: 17 out of 20 in a test. Is that 17 percent? Your parents will hope not!
clip_script: Sipho gets 17 out of 20 in maths. 17 percent? No! Percent means out of a hundred. Make the bottom 100: times 5. 85 out of 100. 85 percent! Now the shops. 10 percent off R350? Divide by 10: R35 off. VAT is 15 percent. On R200? 10 percent is R20, 5 percent is half that, R10. VAT: R30. And 25 percent? That is just a quarter. 25 percent of 480 is 120. Percent means out of a hundred.
visual_style: A test paper with a score flipping from 17/20 to 85/100 to 85 percent, then shop price tags with discount stickers and a till slip showing VAT.
mood: Bright and practical, like a smart shopping trip.
pacing: A gasp at 17 percent, a quick fix, then rapid-fire shop calculations.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find 30 percent off a R250 jacket.
